{{Top|leg}}
'''Reego Hinterstar''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Realspace/Legends|space]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:TDHSP">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=terminal||Take Down Hardened Space Pirate}} on Corellia</ref> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Hinterstar's pirate crew intercepted [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Sava Matar]]'s [[Corvette/Legends|corvette]] ''[[Null Racket]]'' and robbed the cargo. To get his goods back, Matar hired a freelance strike team to track down Hinterstar on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] and retrieve the cargo.<ref name="SWG:TDHSP" />

==Behind the scenes==
Reego Hinterstar was mentioned in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:TDHSP" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Reego Hinterstar was mentioned by name in the mission "Take Down Hardened Space Pirate", that was offered to players on [[mission terminal]]s on Corellia. As all other missions from these terminals, the mission only led the player to a randomly generated base with a small group of thugs that he needs to kill. Hinterstar did not appear in person.<ref name="SWG:TDHSP" />
